summary: Master Advanced Project Economics, Risk, and Decision Analysis through our expert-led training course. Equip yourself with essential tools for project success.
lede: Project economics, risk and decision analysis helps project, finance, controls and risk professionals assess investment options when estimates are uncertain. It covers building discounted cash flow and net present value appraisals, structuring decision trees, and testing project assumptions with Monte Carlo simulation and sensitivity analysis. Learners interpret risk outputs and compare alternatives to prepare evidence-based recommendations and business cases.
audienceIntro: This Advanced Project Economics, Risk and Decision Analysis course is designed for professionals who evaluate project value, test uncertainty, and defend investment choices with spreadsheet-based evidence.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of project finance basics, spreadsheet use in Microsoft Excel, and familiarity with project cost and schedule information. Prior exposure to discounted cash flow concepts is helpful but not required; the course is designed for intermediate to advanced professionals who can work with formulas, assumptions, and scenario comparisons. No coding is required, although you will work with spreadsheet-driven risk modelling and simulation outputs. If your organization uses @RISK or similar add-ins, you will benefit from bringing a laptop and a standard project case or investment memo for practice.
